title: Banach’s simple Lebesgue-spectrum problem

result.label: Banach’s simple Lebesgue-spectrum problem
result.statement: Resolves the probability-preserving form of Banach's simple Lebesgue-spectrum problem within smooth dynamics. A smooth volume-preserving diffeomorphism of the standard-volume three-torus has simple Lebesgue spectrum on its entire complex mean-zero L 2 space: the bilateral iterates of one real observable form an orthonormal basis of that space.
